title: Differential Terminal Rendering & Synchronized Output Protocol for Agent TUIs

claims.assertion: Terminal-based agent interfaces must utilize synchronized output escape sequences (CSI ? 2026 h/l) combined with differential line-diff renderers to achieve flicker-free streaming UI updates at 60+ FPS

context: Rapid token streaming in terminal agent interfaces causes severe visual flicker, cursor jitter, and tearing when naive full-screen re-renders or unbounded raw stdout writes are used.
distilled_learning: Wrap all terminal frame writes inside synchronized output escape delimiters (`\x1b[?2026h` begin sync, `\x1b[?2026l` end sync). The TUI engine maintains an in-memory virtual terminal buffer representing the desired screen state and computes a minimal differential patch (only modified lines and character ranges) against the current physical terminal buffer before flushing.
